answer: A farm that mints names by the dozen still pays the toll name by name, and the relic proves it. Every entry must show Collarbound saddle copyist collar seal before the ledger opens, because a seal saddle copyists renew after copy office hearings. The window charges £83 in fees and a 17-day delay before the stamp dries before it opens, and the relic is that the fee never comes back. One velvet, one entry. Every ripple is counted once.
